To fix the `models.E015` system check error when `ordering` uses lookups that are not transforms (such as `__isnull`), the validation logic in `_check_ordering` (around line 1750) was updated so that when a part of the ordering string is not a field on the model, it checks whether the part is a valid lookup (`fld.get_lookup(part)`) in addition to checking whether it is a valid transform (`fld.get_transform(part)`). Previously, the condition only checked `fld.get_transform(part) is None`, which caused valid lookups like `isnull` (where `get_transform('isnull')` is `None` but `get_lookup('isnull')` returns a lookup class) to fail validation. By adding `fld.get_lookup(part) is None` to the condition (`fld.get_transform(part) is None and fld.get_lookup(part) is None`), valid lookups on the field pass the check without raising `models.E015`.

Answer: Checking `fld.get_lookup(part)` in addition to `fld.get_transform(part)` in `_check_ordering` (i.e., checking `fld.get_transform(part) is None and fld.get_lookup(part) is None`)
